verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no first-party server-side recording or egress-to-bucket feature for MoQ Relay. The only S3 archiving evidence is SageOx's own custom archiver, which subscribes to the relay. That is a user-built consumer on developer building blocks, not a product capability. Relay fan-out and CMAF/HLS support are adjacent features, not recording or storage delivery.

support.subject: As a developer, I can record a session server-side and receive the files in my own storage bucket
